payload.title: EXAMPLE — order total updates after adding a coupon
payload.errorMessage:
expect(locator).toHaveText(expected) failed

Locator: getByTestId('order-total')
Expected: "$81.00"
Received: "$90.00"

note: EXAMPLE — not a real case, format illustration only. This looks like a real pricing bug (wrong total, deterministic-looking assertion) but retried-and-passed points to a discount-recalculation race that only sometimes loses, not a broken discount rule. A one-shot pass/fail read alone would have called this REAL_BUG.
